title: SoK: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Integration in Software Development: Approaches, Gaps, and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2611.08442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standardised post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is critical for protecting software systems against future quantum threats, but standardised algorithms alone do not provide a pathway for their secure integration into software. This paper presents a Systematisation of Knowledge (SoK) of PQC integration in software development, synthesising existing approaches across implementation, migration, and developer education. We analyse these approaches against NIST PQC standards and PQC migration guidance, software development lifecycle coverage, cybersecurity practices, deployment maturity, and testing and evaluation evidence. Our analysis shows that existing work establishes important technical and organisational foundations but provides disconnected support across the software development lifecycle, with limited coordination between preparation, implementation, migration, deployment, maintenance, and developer practices. Evaluation evidence also

translated_title: SoK：后量子密码学（PQC）在软件开发中的集成：方法、差距与未来方向
translated_abstract: 标准化的后量子密码学（PQC）对于保护软件系统抵御未来的量子威胁至关重要，但仅有标准化算法并不能为其安全集成到软件中提供路径。本文对软件开发中的PQC集成进行了知识系统化（Systematisation of Knowledge, SoK）研究，综合梳理了现有在实现、迁移和开发者教育等方面的方法。我们依据NIST PQC标准与PQC迁移指南、软件开发生命周期覆盖范围、网络安全实践、部署成熟度以及测试与评估证据，对这些方法进行了分析。我们的分析表明，现有工作已奠定了重要的技术和组织基础，但在整个软件开发生命周期中所提供的支持是彼此割裂的，在准备、实现、迁移、部署、维护与开发者实践之间缺乏协调。评估证据同样……
tldr: 本文系统梳理了软件开发中后量子密码学集成的研究现状，指出尽管现有工作奠定了重要的技术与组织基础，但各阶段（准备、实现、迁移、部署、维护及开发者实践）之间缺乏协调，生命周期支持仍是割裂的。
en_tdlr: This SoK systematizes research on post-quantum cryptography integration in software development, finding that although existing work establishes important technical and organizational foundations, support remains disconnected across the software development lifecycle.
